title: Empirical Analysis of Multi-Task Learning for Reducing Identity Bias in Toxic Comment Detection
base_benchmarks: Jigsaw Unintended Bias in Toxicity Classification Challenge
findings: The proposed multi-task learning model (MTL-attention) significantly reduced unintended bias against religious identities, particularly 'homosexual', 'muslim', 'black', and 'jewish'. It outperformed baseline models by achieving higher Subgroup AUC and BPSN AUC scores, indicating a lower false positive rate for non-toxic comments mentioning these identities. The case study confirmed the model's robustness, as it assigned consistently low toxicity scores to benign comments and high scores to toxic comments across these identity groups.
